# VIU News

> Vancouver Island University's news hub delivering university announcements, research insights, student stories, and campus updates for the VIU community and media.

VIU News is the official news platform for Vancouver Island University, a Canadian institution based in Nanaimo, BC. It serves as the central hub for press releases, campus announcements, expert directories, alumni spotlights, and community engagement stories.
